title: Predicting angiographic coronary artery disease using machine learning and high-frequency QRS
summary: Prospective HFQRS exercise-ECG model was evaluated against coronary angiography; the healthy-control component limits spectrum generalization. The result is limited to the reported study population and evaluation; the source does not establish transfer to other populations or improved clinical outcomes.
